name: LLM4DyG
description: LLM4DyG is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' spatial-temporal understanding abilities on dynamic graphs through nine specially designed tasks covering temporal and spatial dimensions.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the dynamic-graph/LLM literature that has seen some use in papers on temporal graph reasoning, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: First benchmark to evaluate LLMs on spatial-temporal problems on dynamic graphs; includes a novel prompting method DST2 to improve performance.
